# Official 04A.09 owner review — regression request, diagnostic and result policies

Date: 3 November 2026. **PARTIAL — one bounded owner disposition,
`C09-NATIVE-STRICT-01`, remains.** The six shipping handlers delegate typed
request/options, expanded parameter counts and aligned diagnostic/result plans.
New strict Common validation is implemented and tested; activating its additional
Windows rejection paths is withheld pending the exact-ID timing disposition below.
This is not a claim that the complete definition of done has been accepted.

**P NO; N1 NO GO; N2 NO; Gate C2 UNMET.** No native obligation is discharged.

## Verified source and ownership

Entry was clean on local `main`, HEAD/main

ANOVA/normality/PCA/importer obligations, PID/HWND identity, loaded XLL/assembly
provenance, independent Windows/COM risk approval and 04A.45–48 duties remain open.

The [accepted 04A.02 gate](04A02/04A02-owner-acceptance-2026-11-02.md) requires
pre-change native evidence/release or a fresh exact case/criterion/ID-bound owner
deferral before changing affected native behavior. That retained rule is the
reason for the single disposition below; host-free tests do not waive it.

**Single owner disposition requested: `C09-NATIVE-STRICT-01`** (an administrative
review ID, not a new original obligation): approve the exact-ID deferral of
activating the additional strict Common rejection paths in Windows until the
regression pre-change native capture/risk/timing authority is satisfied. Keep the
shipping observation/legacy-validation mode meanwhile. The crosswalk enumerates
all 34 associated control IDs and the seven original obligation IDs for this
bounded request. The concrete
[unapplied activation patch](../../evidence/04A09/strict-validation-activation.UNAPPLIED.patch)
passes `git apply --check`; it has not been applied. Its target source hash is in
the final source delta and its own hash in the publication manifest.

external reference run, reference promotion or independent scientific review
was performed. All new observations are **NOT_GOLDEN**.

| Candidate | Exact current finding and disposition |
|---|---|
| `C10-LM-ALPHA-01` | Original `LinearModel.Alpha` defaults to 0.05; original RunOLS never assigns it. New intent records requested alpha separately from effective 0.05, and response receives actual `lm.Alpha`. Request alpha 0.10 still yields the existing 95% coefficient intervals. No numerical correction made. |
| `C10-CORE-CONSTANT-01` | Constant binomial response can trigger Core early exit; `GLM.wrapResults` then requests an unavailable Hosmer–Lemeshow payload and throws `NullReferenceException` at its `SetBody` call. Focused direct-Core and projected-path regression fixture asserts the same failure. Proposed future correction: guard/report the unavailable section after early exit, with separately reviewed output/behavior disposition. Core unchanged. |
| `C10-COV-NAMES-01` | Existing `GLM.wrapResults` covariance block aliases `pVarNames` and writes element zero to `Intercept`. The shipping Data header can inherit this mutation. It is preserved. The capture harness subsequently clones names at the Core boundary for reusable request metadata; original capture-source bytes/hash remain private and registry records that test-only delta. All frozen table/vector captures are unchanged. Proposed future correction requires explicit output compatibility review. |
| `C09-NATIVE-STRICT-01` | Previously approved deferral continues. New validation remains diagnostic/observational in Windows. The activation patch stays unapplied. |

Read-only UDF reconnaissance confirms `LM_FIT` explicitly applies its alpha and
fits Type III plus a separate Type I model, while GUI RunOLS keeps its Core default
and selected SS mode. GLM UDF and GUI reuse Core family/link/fit operations, but
UDF strict-input, optional output/cache and GUI native-chart behavior are distinct.

source_contexts.context:
Common tests explicitly compare projected NIST Norris coefficients/SEs in both
cultures. Existing reference tolerances and provenance remain unchanged. No
external reference run, reference promotion or independent scientific review
was performed. All new observations are **NOT_GOLDEN**.

| Candidate | Exact current finding and disposition |
|---|---|
| `C10-LM-ALPHA-01` | Original `LinearModel.Alpha` defaults to 0.05; original RunOLS never assigns it. New intent records requested alpha separately from effective 0.05, and response receives actual `lm.Alpha`. Request alpha 0.10 still yields the existing 95% coefficient intervals. No numerical correction made. |
| `C10-CORE-CONSTANT-01` | Constant binomial response can trigger Core early exit; `GLM.wrapResults` then requests an unavailable Hosmer–Lemeshow payload and throws `NullReferenceException` at its `SetBody` call. Focused direct-Core and projected-path regression fixture asserts the same failure. Proposed future correction: guard/report the unavailable section after early exit, with separately reviewed output/behavior disposition. Core unchanged. |
| `C10-COV-NAMES-01` | Existing `GLM.wrapResults` covariance block aliases `pVarNames` and writes element zero to `Intercept`. The shipping Data header can inherit this mutation. It is preserved. The capture harness subsequently clones names at the Core boundary for reusable request metadata; original capture-source bytes/hash remain private and registry records that test-only delta. All frozen table/vector captures are unchanged. Proposed future correction requires explicit output compatibility review. |
| `C09-NATIVE-STRICT-01` | Previously approved deferral continues. New validation remains diagnostic/observational in Windows. The activation patch stays unapplied. |

Read-only UDF reconnaissance confirms `LM_FIT` explicitly applies its alpha and
fits Type III plus a separate Type I model, while GUI RunOLS keeps its Core default
and selected SS mode. GLM UDF and GUI reuse Core family/link/fit operations, but
UDF strict-input, optional output/cache and GUI native-chart behavior are distinct.
No UDF surface was rewritten to force equivalence. Earlier C08 label/formula
limitations and 04A.05/06/07 candidates remain open.

[Current issue records](../../evidence/04A11/issues-final.json) contain source/test
hashes, all affected original control/obligation IDs, numerical dispositions and
next owners. Earlier current-batch receipts are retained, with explicit successor
links; accepted older records were not rewritten.

|---|---|---|
| `C10-LM-ALPHA-01` | **PORTABLE_FIXED_NATIVE_PENDING**; GUI switch **UNAPPLIED_GATED** | Portable intent uses requested finite alpha, with existing validation and .05 default. Tests assign it before Core fitting: .10 gives 90% CIs, .05 gives 95%; coefficients, SEs and fitted rows remain exact. Shipping RunOLS explicitly selects `NativeLegacyDefault`, so actual .05 is reported truthfully until activation. |

The Windows classification tail is skipped only when no report data exists; completed fits, including nonconverged fits, retain their original post-fit controls/chart order. |

Windows temporarily reproduces its previous Data header on a separate display-name clone; no erroneous naming rule is embedded in Common or treated as permanent correctness. |

limitations and 04A.05/06/07 candidates remain open.

## Numerical and semantic evidence

[Baseline registry](../../evidence/04A14/baseline-registry.json) pins **100 pre-production-edit captures**: 25 original Core cases × invariant/sk-SK × net10/net48. The capture fixture was frozen before product changes; its first compile correction is retained in raw evidence. Captures include input blocks/permutation, coefficients/covariance/DF/p-values/theta/fitted/residual arrays, fit status and every original table cell/type/order/header/footer/p-value coordinate. All 100 complete; four capture variants record the intentional one-iteration nonconverged LMM.

Cases include MMRM Identity/CS/AR1/UN/CSH/Toeplitz, missing longitudinal observations, ML/REML and all GUI inference/fallback choices; Orthodont KR; LMM intercept/slope/VC, optional-visit behavior, sleepstudy and unbalanced slopes. Further tests compare three BFGS configurations to original Core request construction; four weighting/covariate reference profiles and original Core linear-estimate tables; directed signs; cancellation/interruption; five deficient/tied designs and bounded negative inputs. Original Core/Windows KR, Satterthwaite and existing reference CSV suites run in the full matrix.

Compatibility tolerance is **max(1e-9, abs(expected)×1e-9)** for doubles, accommodating runtime roundoff in the same calculation. Labels/order/CLR kinds/nulls/metadata are exact. Only computational timing-value cells are masked. [Numerical comparisons](../../evidence/04A14/numerical-comparisons.json) lists each capture, table schema and status. Memory-writer parity proves neutral values/placement plans, not Excel placement or event safety.

| Ui19LMM | `dc354d6d85d96da12087be74b94ee485ab4bdc937bd023408112e985e91ce381` | `26a9b3760293fafc4dfa698514abe59bb4ef00f0b10720fd3787fe05d6376e93` |

Changed whole-form pins receive honest main-entry/successor provenance in `source-delta.json`; original records were not replaced. `C09-NATIVE-STRICT-01`, `C11-NATIVE-CORRECTIONS-01`, `C12-NATIVE-CLASSIFICATION-01` remain **UNAPPLIED** at their original bytes; all three `git apply --check` checks pass. No shared helper activates them. No native timing exception was requested or reused.

| Later owner | Exact retained boundary |
|---|---|
| 04A.15 | Deep R/G covariance and optimizer/fitting specialization/combination coverage, using the new lossless request options and original Core engines |
| 04A.16 | Deeper reference-grid/LS-means/KR/Satt diagnostics mapping; `BuildMMRMReferenceGridGroupContrastsTable`, additional factors/covariates in `BuildMMRMReferenceGridSpec`, grouping/selected baseline/control/comparison resolution, MMRM class builder and LMM `AppendLMMClassInfoTable`/`AppendClassInfoRows` |
| 04A.39–41, 04A.45–48 | Input/UDF distinctions and `C14-INPUT-FINITE-01`, exact invalid-input/native decisions; C13 scientific issue remains separately owned |
| 04A.28/36, 04A.45–47 | Native output/placement/chart work if separately authorized; current writers/trace/residual tables remain Windows-owned |

The remaining pure post-estimation helpers are an explicit 04A.16 handoff, not claimed as already portable. No new plot or Office UI was implemented. **P NO; N1 NO GO; N2 NO; Gate C2 UNMET.**

## Validation commands and actual outcomes

[Entry measurements](../../evidence/04A14/entry-validation.json) are from the merged live checkout: Debug Core **1058/1058**, Common **1662/1667**, Windows **1605/1607**; comparable Python **676/744**, **68 nonpasses**. The initial Common Python probe lacked the G3 observation environment (168 methods, 27 nonpasses); fresh unchanged C02 representative-source observations remove its 17 environment-only errors. Both attempts are retained. Release/Office/Node entry were not separately executed; they are not claimed as measured entry totals. The final matrices measure both configurations.

| Full suite | Debug passed / total | Release passed / total |
|---|---:|---:|

| Projected BFGS (finite-difference gradient) | `ProjectedBfgs` | `NumericalFiniteDifference` exact-label override, ignoring case |
| Unknown nonblank MMRM token | `ProjectedBfgs` | Separate gradient parser |
| Unknown nonblank LMM token | `AverageInformationReml` | Separate gradient parser |

All original optimizer/gradient parser literals and shipping labels, including case/outer-spacing variants, are compared against frozen `LegacyMixed14Options` plus prechange control construction. An outer-spaced label can parse differently from an exact-label override; that distinction is retained. Gradients map Auto/Analytic/analytic-with-finite-difference-validation/Numerical to their original four enum values. Validation mode is distinct from numerical optimization. Core's analytic-optimizer override and provider/AI fallback are unchanged; AI attempts REML and may fall back to projected BFGS for ML or unusable AI results.

GUI fit selection recognizes ML ignoring case and otherwise retains REML; the broader UDF helper grammar remains intentionally separate. KR's case-insensitive ML guard still coerces REML while the original case-sensitive inference selection retains model-specific fallbacks (MMRM between-within, LMM Wald). Unknown inference/optimizer/gradient values are not normalized to a new effective scientific choice.

## 4. Numerical and negative evidence

[Baseline and lineage](../../evidence/04A15/baseline-and-lineage.json) verifies all original 100 04A.14 captures at original SHA-256/bytes: 25 cases x invariant/sk-SK x net10/net48. They are unchanged compatibility references, **NOT_GOLDEN**. Their frozen capture-source identity is retained. Existing Orthodont, sleepstudy, unbalanced/missing longitudinal, KR/Satterthwaite and original report-order regressions run unchanged.

[New versioned fit comparisons](../../evidence/04A15/fit-comparisons-v1.json) record 176 new fit combinations x two cultures x two frameworks x two configurations. Original factory/control requests and specialized requests use the same unchanged Core. Coefficients, theta, covariance, objective, DF/inference, fitted/residual arrays and original table cell kinds/order/metadata are compared. This is same-engine compatibility, not independent statistical validation. The 12-iteration new matrix deliberately preserves nonconverged outcomes; those are not relabelled converged/PASS fits.

The 1,408 recorded comparisons retain **712 CONVERGED and 696 NONCONVERGED** outcomes. None of those 176 supported fit combinations was rejected by Core. Invalid-Q rejection is separately asserted; metadata-only pairs, including `None`, are not counted as fits.

Tolerance was fixed before fitting: `max(1e-9, abs(expected)*1e-9)` for doubles, exact nonnumeric/shape/status/order/metadata. Only computational timing cells are masked by the unchanged canonicalizer. No tolerance or old expectation was tuned. Separate gradient modes, all optimizer cancellation/interruption and one-iteration limits, zero/constant responses, unsupported/oversized Q, malformed/null data, nonfinite tolerances, iteration extremes, source RowIds/permutation, copy isolation and factory logger/failure boundaries have executable coverage. Public evidence distinguishes selected metadata, actual fits, nonconvergence and Core rejection.

| Form | Original controls | OPEN obligations | Restricted controls |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Ui18MMRM | 93 | 40 | 39 |
| Ui19LMM | 84 | 29 | 28 |
| Total | 177 | 69 | 67 |

Zero controls released; zero obligations discharged or invented. Original broader populations remain 1,514 obligations/802 restricted controls; transferred 239/218; ANOVA/normality 160/141; importer 44; 2x2 three; UiGLM seven/34; GEE 35/34; survival 12/10. These overlap and must never be added together or narrowed through this batch.

`C09-NATIVE-STRICT-01`, `C11-NATIVE-CORRECTIONS-01` and `C12-NATIVE-CLASSIFICATION-01` remain UNAPPLIED at their original bytes, with current `git apply --check` tests. `C13-LOGRANK-R-01` remains an OPEN scientific defect; its source/evidence is untouched. `C14-INPUT-FINITE-01` remains an OPEN candidate diagnostic. **P=NO; N1=NO GO; N2=NO; Gate C2=UNMET.**

04A.16 retains deep LS-means/reference grids/contrasts/KR/Satt/result diagnostics. 04A.39-41 retain cross-consumer/scientific reconciliation; 04A.45-48 retain native attribution, controlled prechange observation, parity and exit gates. No post-estimation engine or Office fitting UI was added.

## 6. Validation commands, totals and nonpasses

[Final validation](../../evidence/04A15/validation.json) uses the last complete Debug/Release matrices. Per-suite managed rows below count framework executions; the distinct-logical row reconciles shared linked tests by source SHA and data-row identity, retaining the established Mixed14 typed-null cohorts. Repeats are excluded. There are no managed or Node skips.

| Suite/check | Debug passed / total | Release passed / total | Exit / qualification |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Core managed | 1,058 / 1,058 | 1,058 / 1,058 | 0 each |

| Weighting | Equal cells or observed class-cell frequency. Core owns profile ordering, joint cell counts, normalization, L vectors and footnotes |
| Continuous covariates | Shipping GUI supports observed means or zero. A nonzero portable requested `CovariateValue` is candidate-diagnosed and does not invent a GUI control; existing direct Core explicit-value services remain unchanged |
| Multiplicity / alpha | None, Bonferroni, Holm, Sidak delegated to Core. Reference-grid family is the full contrast table across profiles/visits; raw and adjusted p-values retained, CIs unadjusted. Observed-design contrasts remain unadjusted despite a selected multiplicity setting. Existing Core alpha fallback is projected as metadata, not reimplemented probability math |
| Fit/inference status | Converged, nonconverged, cancelled, interrupted, failed/unavailable; requested accepted decision and actual Core fit/inference remain distinct. Presence of a workspace is availability metadata, not proof that KR inference is valid |
| Diagnostics | Core warnings in order, alpha fallback, coefficient/covariance availability/nonfinite/negative-diagonal candidates, actual optimizer/provider and trace/support/restart/KR finite-difference availability. At most 128 structured warnings; existing Core diagnostic tables retain their original order/data |
| Optional failure | Missing/failed optional table is omitted and candidate-diagnosed; other tables continue. Reference specification/row failure retains the original outer-catch boundary and existing class output. No replacement zero effect, invented DF or new strict Windows rejection |
| LMM | Existing class/G/R/BLUP/inference/diagnostic/report behavior only. Portable Core reference estimates can be requested explicitly from characterized Core services; no LMM GUI editor/report switch was added |

Portable request validation remains separate from the acquired Windows path. `C14-INPUT-FINITE-01` and new post-fit candidate checks do not activate stricter host refusal. Source RowIds are copied only when supplied; the X/visit/group axis follows acquisition order, while Core's subject/visit permutations remain separate. Neither positional arrays nor reference rows fabricate worksheet coordinates. No long-lived full-size design or KR workspace snapshot is retained in Common.

Example: create a `MixedModelPostEstimationIntent` after acquiring/refreshing data-dependent choices, call `ProjectMMRM` or `ProjectReference` with the fitted result and existing Core services, inspect its ordered sections/warnings, and materialize through `LegacyTables`. Windows `ApplySupplemental` and final `MixedModelReportPolicy.Project` are the shipping consumers; standalone consumers can use the detached documents directly. Existing public report enums and `MixedModelReferenceIntent` are reused, not duplicated.

## 4. Numerical and inference compatibility

[Retained evidence](../../evidence/04A16/retained-evidence.json) verifies all original **100** 04A.14 captures and the original 04A.15 ledger at unchanged SHA-256/bytes. The latter remains **1,408** same-Core comparisons, **712 converged / 696 nonconverged**. Nothing was regenerated, cherry-picked, replaced or promoted. All are **NOT_GOLDEN** compatibility references.

[Frozen selection provenance](../../evidence/04A16/legacy-selection-provenance.json) pins six actual prechange form methods and their test-only derivative. Only visibility and original ComboBox text acquisition were adapted to copied strings; Core calls, parser ordering, comparison branches and errors remain intact. The independent assembly of original Core calls is a regression oracle, not independent statistical validation.

[Fresh comparisons](../../evidence/04A16/post-estimation-comparisons-v1.json) records 192 specified-coefficient/covariance option profiles across invariant/sk-SK, net10/net48 and Debug/Release: **1,536** execution records. Those synthetic profiles are **not fits**. These are source-backed synthetic compatibility fixtures, not independent numerical references. Existing Core and Windows numerical reference suites/fixtures run unchanged. Rejected Core combinations stay rejected. Completed calculation, k-means convergence and FA extraction/rotation flags are separately recorded; completion is never renamed convergence. Negative calls retain original return/exception classes and messages.

The ledger contains **1,224** profile executions and **48** negative-call records. Of the profile executions, **120** preserve original hierarchical ArgumentException rejections; **192** k-means runs report convergence; **168** FA runs report extraction/rotation convergence and **72** retain nonconverged extraction with converged rotation. The other **672** record completed Core calls without inventing an iterative convergence status. Thus 1,104 returned calculations is not a claim of 1,104 converged fits. Each logical request is repeated across cultures/frameworks/configurations; these execution counts are not distinct statistical datasets.

source_contexts.context:
## 4. Row identity issue remains OPEN and uncorrected

**C19-CLUSTER-ROWID-DISPLAY-01** is reproduced in both clustering families. For source RowIds `101,105,118,131`, deleting input position 2 leaves input ordinals `1,3,4`, physical source rows `101,118,131` and hierarchical active leaves `1,2,3`; new internal IDs are `4,5`. Leaf-order positions are a separate permutation. Duplicate/Unicode labels are display text, never identifiers.

The Data sheet's OriginalRow contains physical source RowIds. Existing Core assignment/membership/removed-row OriginalRow cells contain 1-based analysis input positions. These headings/cells are unchanged. The portable observation map contains the correct physical identity alongside the legacy ordinal and active/removed/leaf/member axes. A future corrected output could select SourceRowId from this mapping, but no output activation or silent heading/cell rewrite is shipped. [Disposition and reproduction](../../evidence/04A19/cluster-rowid-disposition.json) assigns future ownership to 04A.28 / 04A.39–42 or a separately approved timing exception, subject to the original applicable native and visible-behavior owner decision.

No selected label preserves Core `Obs 1`, `Obs 2`, … and omits Data RowLabel. Selected blank labels retain the Windows `Row {RowId}` fallback before capture. These modes, noncontiguous/reordered source rows, deletion, repeated labels and defensive copies are tested.

Two additional candidates remain unmodified: **C19-HIERARCHICAL-NONFINITE-POWER-01** (NaN Minkowski power reaches Fit and throws the current dictionary-key error; positive infinity can return an unvalidated result) and **C19-HIERARCHICAL-INVERSION-CUT-01** (centroid/median points `(-1,0),(1,0),(0,1.8)`, heights 2 then 1.8, cut 1.9 returns three memberships because Core stops at the first higher merge). Neither is repaired or newly blocked in Common/Windows. Future scientific/report owners are 04A.40–41 and, for reporting, 04A.28. See [candidate issues](../../evidence/04A19/candidate-issues.json).

## 5. Same-Core corpus, never a scientific golden

The [versioned corpus](../../evidence/04A19/kmeans-hierarchical-projection-comparisons-v1.json) contains **2,478 executed records**, **1,241 content-addressed payloads**, actual test/TRX links, configuration/OS/TFM/runtime/culture, fixture/source SHA, option/seed/sentinel/effective seed and original-scale centre shape/digest, source/active/removed/merge/leaf identities, labels, membership/centre/scale/schedule/table hashes, section/plot sequence and convergence/exception phase. Report-rejected fits retain available actual Core axes; earlier rejections explicitly have unavailable results. Counts classify outcomes, not scientific success.

Every record is **NOT_GOLDEN / SAME_CORE_COMPATIBILITY_ONLY**. Direct Core versus request calls use identical inputs/options and fixed seeds. Discrete identities/CLR kinds/order and nonfinite classes compare exactly; same-runtime numerical arrays use exact typed digests. Existing table comparison uses finite tolerance `max(1e-9, abs(expected)*1e-9)`, declared before comparison. There is no cluster relabelling, leaf normalization, alternate distance engine or tolerance tuning to erase differences. Synthetic basic values match the read-only historical CSV; edge fixtures, the documented protein example and frozen 17 profiles have explicit provenance roles. The protein screenshots/example claims were not retested.

For source RowIds `101,105,118,131`, deleting input position 2 leaves input ordinals `1,3,4`, physical source rows `101,118,131` and hierarchical active leaves `1,2,3`; new internal IDs are `4,5`. Leaf-order positions are a separate permutation. Duplicate/Unicode labels are display text, never identifiers.

The Data sheet's OriginalRow contains physical source RowIds. Existing Core assignment/membership/removed-row OriginalRow cells contain 1-based analysis input positions. These headings/cells are unchanged. The portable observation map contains the correct physical identity alongside the legacy ordinal and active/removed/leaf/member axes. A future corrected output could select SourceRowId from this mapping, but no output activation or silent heading/cell rewrite is shipped. [Disposition and reproduction](../../evidence/04A19/cluster-rowid-disposition.json) assigns future ownership to 04A.28 / 04A.39–42 or a separately approved timing exception, subject to the original applicable native and visible-behavior owner decision.

No selected label preserves Core `Obs 1`, `Obs 2`, … and omits Data RowLabel. Selected blank labels retain the Windows `Row {RowId}` fallback before capture. These modes, noncontiguous/reordered source rows, deletion, repeated labels and defensive copies are tested.

Two additional candidates remain unmodified: **C19-HIERARCHICAL-NONFINITE-POWER-01** (NaN Minkowski power reaches Fit and throws the current dictionary-key error; positive infinity can return an unvalidated result) and **C19-HIERARCHICAL-INVERSION-CUT-01** (centroid/median points `(-1,0),(1,0),(0,1.8)`, heights 2 then 1.8, cut 1.9 returns three memberships because Core stops at the first higher merge). Neither is repaired or newly blocked in Common/Windows. Future scientific/report owners are 04A.40–41 and, for reporting, 04A.28. See [candidate issues](../../evidence/04A19/candidate-issues.json).

## 5. Same-Core corpus, never a scientific golden

The [versioned corpus](../../evidence/04A19/kmeans-hierarchical-projection-comparisons-v1.json) contains **2,478 executed records**, **1,241 content-addressed payloads**, actual test/TRX links, configuration/OS/TFM/runtime/culture, fixture/source SHA, option/seed/sentinel/effective seed and original-scale centre shape/digest, source/active/removed/merge/leaf identities, labels, membership/centre/scale/schedule/table hashes, section/plot sequence and convergence/exception phase. Report-rejected fits retain available actual Core axes; earlier rejections explicitly have unavailable results. Counts classify outcomes, not scientific success.

Every record is **NOT_GOLDEN / SAME_CORE_COMPATIBILITY_ONLY**. Direct Core versus request calls use identical inputs/options and fixed seeds. Discrete identities/CLR kinds/order and nonfinite classes compare exactly; same-runtime numerical arrays use exact typed digests. Existing table comparison uses finite tolerance `max(1e-9, abs(expected)*1e-9)`, declared before comparison. There is no cluster relabelling, leaf normalization, alternate distance engine or tolerance tuning to erase differences. Synthetic basic values match the read-only historical CSV; edge fixtures, the documented protein example and frozen 17 profiles have explicit provenance roles. The protein screenshots/example claims were not retested.

Accept **only 04A.24 portable multivariate SPC post-fit software extraction**, if the independent owner review agrees with this code and evidence. Actual combined host population is **187 controls / 30 linked OPEN obligations**. These host-wide records include unrelated modes and overlap with native/source obligations. They are not added to overall original **3,866 source members / 2,056 controls / 1,514 obligations**, nor to 04A.27's **44 OPEN importer obligations**. Exact IDs/original hashes and 04A.02 blocked-control overlap are in `original-control-crosswalk.json` and `restriction-retention.json`.

Historical results: **270444 files**, exact membership and file identity/size/creation-write metadata retained. This is explicitly a metadata preservation check, not a claim of rereading every large TestResults byte. **1779 authority/corpus hashes** were separately verified, with **1778 entry-exact files** and only the excluded owner Master Plan revision differing. Previous 04A.25 registry reconciliation: `{'EXACT': 1713, 'ENTRY_OWNER_AUTHORITY_CHANGE': 1}`; differences are recorded without altering history. The original 100 mixed-model hashes and prior PSM bucket hashes are independently checked.
